messages:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up — ran the multilingual eval on the new int8 build (model-x-int8-2026-03-15). Seeing a BLEU drop for zh->en and ja->en (~6-8%), plus some weird detokenization for mixed hangul+latin lines. Sample attached below.

tokenizer-ci: CI alert: tokenization-regression (mixed-script) triggered 3 failures. See /ci/jobs/4421 — investigation recommended. :rotating_light:

Hao Li: Can you paste the minimal failing example and the token stream?

Mia Chen: sure — here's one of the failing inputs and outputs:
```
Input: "이번 프로젝트는 v2 API와 함께 배포됩니다 — see details at https://example.com/リリース
Expected detok: 이번 프로젝트는 v2 API와 함께 배포됩니다 — see details at https://example.com/リリース
Observed detok: 이번 프로젝트는 v2 API와 함께 배포됩니다 — see details at https://example . com / リ リ ー ス
Tokens (encode): [▁이번, ▁프로, 젝, 트, 는, ▁v2, ▁API, 와, ▁함께, ▁배포, 됩, 니, 다, ▁—, ▁see, ▁details, ▁at, ▁https, ://, example, .com, /, リ, リ, ー, ス]
```

Yuki Tanaka: hmm looks like normalization changed — I'm seeing extra splitting around emoji/ZWJ-like sequences and some kana being split into repeated subpieces. We switched normalizer from NFKC to NFC in tokenizer lib to speed things up last month (PR #856). That could explain kana resegmentation.

Samir Patel: IIRC the runtime v2.3 patch included a micro-optim to skip composing marks during pre-token normalize. Could be the same change surfaced after model quantization because kv-prefetch logic changed tokenization order. I filed an issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TECH-412 (runtime normalizer regression).

Hao Li: quick reproducer command I used: 
```bash
python -m evals.run --model model-x-int8-2026-03-15 --dataset multilang-mix --subset mixed-script --save-failures failures.json
# commit: abc123def (quantize + pruning pass)
```
Repro is deterministic for me locally.

tokenizer-ci: Auto-report: tokenization-regression failed on zh_ja_ko_mixed, emoji-zwj, and cjk-punct tests. Full diff attached: /ci/artifacts/4421/diff.html

Nora Alvarez: let's triage: rollback the normalizer change on Dedicated and host pin to previous runtime until we confirm. Action items: @Samir open hotfix PR, @Yuki add specific normalization tests (kana/ZWJ/emoji/AR diacritics), @Mia add failing examples to regression set, @Hao run full BLEU eval on the pinned runtime. I'll coordinate the deploy window.

Mia Chen: created ticket TECH-827 and uploaded failures.json and the sample inputs (see ticket). Planning to add these to the regression harness now.

Samir Patel: I'll draft a hotfix PR that reverts the micro-opt and adds unit tests. If CI green I'll request a canary deploy tonight.

Yuki Tanaka: adding note — please also include NFC vs NFKC normalization cases for Arabic and RTL, I suspect diacritic combining order may change outputs for ar->en as well.

Hao Li: running full eval now on previous runtime (model-x-int8-2026-03-15 pinned to runtime v2.2). Will post BLEU numbers in ~30m.

Mia Chen: thanks — if we can canary tonight that would limit customer impact (we've seen a few support tickets about punctuation breakage). :thumbsup:

tokenizer-ci: CI: job 4421 requeued after comment. Watching for new artifacts.

Nora Alvarez: assigning owners in TECH-827. We'll follow up in the issue thread; keeping this channel for quick sync.

Samir Patel: hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/922 — includes revert + tests. tagging @yuki @hao for review.

Mia Chen: ack. thanks everyone.

Hao Li: preliminary BLEU numbers on pinned runtime: zh->en recovered (~+7 BLEU), ja->en recovered (~+6 BLEU). Looks like normalization was the primary cause. I'll run extended tests and post full report.

Nora Alvarez: great — once PR merged we'll roll canary and monitor eval metrics + customer reports. Closing loop in TECH-827. :white_check_mark:
